description: The line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for two methods—random and end—across a series of input phrases, with the title indicating that the data corresponds to the SST-2 dataset using clean-label poisoning at a rate of 5% (2.6% of the total). The x-axis displays a sequence of input phrases: "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully", arranged in a categorical order. The y-axis represents the ASR, ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with a linear scale. The "random" method is represented by an orange line with 'x' markers, while the "end" method is shown as a purple line with circular markers. The "random" method starts at an ASR of approximately 0.55 for "bb", drops sharply to 0.2 for "cf", and then rises to 0.9 for "beautifully". The "end" method begins at an ASR of 0.55 for "bb", increases to 0.85 for "cf", and then fluctuates, peaking at 0.9 for "wonderful" before decreasing to 0.8 for "beautifully".
